mapper.select: SELECT chgbill_status, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(chgbill_amount) AS amount FROM charge_bill WHERE rental_pty_id = #{rentalPtyId} AND chgbill_charge_month = #{chgbillChargeMonth} GROUP BY chgbill_status

SELECT a.*, c.BLDG_NM, b.UNIT_ROOM, d.MBR_NM FROM charge_bill a INNER JOIN unit b ON (a.unit_id = b.unit_id) INNER JOIN building c ON (b.bldg_id = c.bldg_id) INNER JOIN member d ON (b.mbr_cd = d.mbr_cd) WHERE a.CHGBILL_CHARGE_MONTH = #{chgbillChargeMonth} AND a.UNIT_ID = #{unitId}
mapper.update: UPDATE CHARGE_BILL SET CHGBILL_STATUS = '004' WHERE CHGBILL_STATUS = '001' AND TO_DATE(CHGBILL_DUE_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
